sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "business_profiles" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" = 1), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "vat_number" TEXT NOT NULL, "kvk_number" TEXT NOT NULL, "address" TEXT NOT NULL, "iban" TEXT NOT NULL, "kor_start" INTEGER NULL, "kor_end" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "clients" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "country" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NL', "vat_number" TEXT NULL, "kvk_number" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NOT NULL, "contact_person" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "wet_dba_risk" TEXT NOT NULL, "contract_signed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("contract_signed" IN (0, 1)), "contract_expiry" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "is_merchant_of_record" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_merchant_of_record" IN (0, 1)), "is_consumer" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_consumer" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "invoices" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "invoice_number" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "invoice_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "corrected_invoice_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES invoices (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "invoice_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "supply_date" INTEGER NULL, "client_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES clients (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "vat_treatment" TEXT NOT NULL, "self_billed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("self_billed" IN (0, 1)), "seller_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "seller_vat_number" TEXT NOT NULL, "seller_kvk_number" TEXT NOT NULL, "seller_address" TEXT NOT NULL, "seller_iban" TEXT NOT NULL, "payment_term_days" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "paid_date" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "total_excl_vat" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_vat" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_incl_vat" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "invoice_lines" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "invoice_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES invoices (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NULL, "unit_price_excl_vat" INTEGER NOT NULL, "vat_rate" TEXT NOT NULL, "vat_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "line_total_excl_vat" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fixed_assets" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'general', "asset_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "cost_excl_vat" INTEGER NOT NULL, "vat_rate" TEXT NULL, "purchase_vat" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'domestic', "vat_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "vat_reclaimable" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("vat_reclaimable" IN (0, 1)), "vat_to_reclaim" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "residual_value" INTEGER NOT NULL, "purchase_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "business_use_pct" REAL NOT NULL, "useful_life_years" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kia_eligible" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("kia_eligible" IN (0, 1)), "eia_eligible" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("eia_eligible" IN (0, 1)), "mia_category" TEXT NULL, "investment_deduction_received" INTEGER NULL, "reinvestment_reserve_applied" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "reserve_gain" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("reserve_gain" IN (0, 1)), "catalogue_value" INTEGER NULL, "first_registration" INTEGER NULL, "zero_emission" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "market_value" INTEGER NULL, "keeps_trip_log" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("keeps_trip_log" IN (0, 1)), "notes" TEXT NULL, "disposal_date" INTEGER NULL, "disposal_proceeds" INTEGER NULL, "disposal_invoice_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES invoices (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "disposal_vat_rate" TEXT NULL, "disposal_vat_amount" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expenses" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "supplier" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "paper_original_kept" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("paper_original_kept" IN (0, 1)), "amount_excl_vat" INTEGER NOT NULL, "vat_rate" TEXT NOT NULL, "purchase_vat" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'domestic', "vat_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_incl_vat" INTEGER NOT NULL, "business_use_pct" REAL NOT NULL, "deductible_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "vat_reclaimable" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("vat_reclaimable" IN (0, 1)), "vat_to_reclaim" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "paid_from" TEXT NULL, "payment_reference" TEXT NULL, "gift_recipient" TEXT NULL, "car_asset_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES fixed_assets (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "hour_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "work_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "hours" REAL NOT NULL, "client_project" TEXT NULL, "client_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES clients (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "notes" TEXT NULL, "by_partner" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("by_partner" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mileage_trips" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "car_asset_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES fixed_assets (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "vehicle_make_model" TEXT NOT NULL, "vehicle_license_plate" TEXT NOT NULL, "departure_address" TEXT NOT NULL, "arrival_address" TEXT NOT NULL, "odometer_start" INTEGER NOT NULL, "odometer_end" INTEGER NOT NULL, "trip_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "purpose" TEXT NOT NULL, "route_deviation" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("route_deviation" IN (0, 1)), "notes" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pension_entries" ("year" INTEGER NOT NULL, "prior_year_income" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "factor_a" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "reserveringsruimte" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "planned_contribution" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "aov_insured" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("aov_insured" IN (0, 1)), "monthly_aov_premium" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("year"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vat_returns" ("year" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'quarterly', "number" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("number" BETWEEN 1 AND 12), "filed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("filed" IN (0, 1)), "paid" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("paid" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("year", "kind", "number"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tax_year_inputs" ("year" INTEGER NOT NULL, "partner_hours" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "partner_pay" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "has_so_verklaring" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("has_so_verklaring" IN (0, 1)), "so_starter" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("so_starter" IN (0, 1)), "business_ceased" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("business_ceased" IN (0, 1)), "stakingsaftrek_used_before" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "disability_benefit" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("disability_benefit" IN (0, 1)), "disability_starters_used" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "unrealised_zelfstandigenaftrek" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "loss_carry_forward" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "employed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("employed" IN (0, 1)), "wages" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "wage_tax_withheld" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "zvw_wages" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "employment_hours" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "not_ondernemer_before" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("not_ondernemer_before" IN (0, 1)), "is_starter" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_starter" IN (0, 1)), "vat_filing_period" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'quarterly', PRIMARY KEY ("year"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "receipts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "expense_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES expenses (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "asset_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES fixed_assets (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "invoice_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES invoices (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "year" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "original_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "added_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "removed_at" INTEGER NULL, "removed_from_kind" TEXT NULL, "removed_from_date" INTEGER NULL, "removed_from_name" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((expense_id IS NOT NULL) + (asset_id IS NOT NULL) + (invoice_id IS NOT NULL) <= 1), CHECK (removed_at IS NOT NULL OR (expense_id IS NOT NULL) + (asset_id IS NOT NULL) + (invoice_id IS NOT NULL) = 1), CHECK (removed_at IS NULL OR (removed_from_kind IS NOT NULL AND removed_from_date IS NOT NULL AND removed_from_name IS NOT NULL)));
